title: [GMCP 203.037.02] Production path: Configuration import, export, migration, and desired state
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-037-02. Implement the canonical state, types, and primary production path. Replace stubs, demo-only paths, duplicated semantics, and implicit ambient state; preserve compatible behavior through explicit adapters; and make the new path reachable from the shipped GMCP runtime. Vector outcome: GMCP losslessly imports and exports major MCP host configurations while separating secrets, preserving unknown fields and reporting unsupported semantics. One versioned desired-state schema covers servers, transports, auth, sandbox, policy and extensions; migrations are reversible and idempotent; layered overrides explain provenance; and concurrent edits use validation plus atomic conflict handling. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
